title: Superweapons
text: The two great superweapons of the old wars: the GLA's **SCUD Storm** and China's **Nuclear Missile**. Each is a structure of its own, takes only its own ammunition (built at a factory of its own faction, the **Arms Dealer** or the **War Factory**), charges for minutes on power and is fired from a [Launch Computer](ordnance/launch_site). When one is built, readied or launched, everyone in the dimension hears the warning.
